reviews.review_description: Solar representative very knowledgable factual, and transparent with all aspects of the install and available options.The installation occurred on time and was trouble free.Installers were friendly, courteous and informative taking time to answer any questions we had.The work request for grid feed-in was arranged promptly with my provider and I was notified by my provider of  it's receipt in less than a weeks time.
Sales was great.The install guys did a good job.

We had a 9.90 kW PV solar system installed by OTI Power (Suntech panels and Sungrow inverter). The pre-sale, installation, and post installation have all been very good experiences. We are very happy that we chose OTI Power.

Easy and informative quoting process, listened to my requirements and worked with me to get the right system.Installation was fast and problem free, products requested were used.Overall interactions with OTI were very easy and they took care of everything I needed with minimal chasing.

The sales process was seamless. Not pushy and incredibly informative. Booking went smoothly and was slotted in very quickly, exceeding my expectations on delivery.Installation was great. Very courteous team, who were professional and efficient.I would recommend OTI without hesitation.

The quoting process was honest and tailored to our usage and future requirements.The installation was booked in quickly and at a day that suited us.The installation was quick, no fuss and the team were very politeThe organised the grid connection and all is running well.

Pete from Oti Power was very helpful during the quoting process, answering my endless questions, helping me decide whether to purchase an optimising system and providing lots of advice.  The installers were excellent.  Customer service was great.  Pete called me on the Saturday morning after the installation on the Friday and talked me through the monitoring app and how to use it.  I'm very happy with my solar installation and wish I had done it years ago.  This is the first time that I am actually looking forward to receiving my electricity bill!!
The quoting process was staight forwardInstallation was smooth. Installers were polite & helpful with my questionsThe did organise  the paperwork re install digital meter
Good customer service and well pricedPete from OTI Power very good to deal with
Quoting process was good. Lots of info supplied. Installation was efficient, considering it was sprinkling rain on and off all day. They were very safety conscious!Follow up service also good.

Quote process was good all questions answered and a solution to suit our needs, quality and budget provided.Installers were polite and tidy. Very efficient.The service was great from quote to install. Meter upgrade organised and after service very good. The entire process was an efficient and pleasant experience. Peter was really helpful.
Great service and product. Good communication from start to finish.Highly recommended

Solar quotes made it easier in digging through the mine field of information and misinformation. It is well worth watching Finns information videos to get a basic understanding.OTI power weâ€™re responsive in answering our questions to try to get a system that would work for us.  They started at a RollsRoyce system and then backed down to a system that was cost effective but value for us.Very happy with the SolarEdge inverter and monitoring that Comes with it.

The supplier was prompt in contacting us to provide a quote and to follow up to ensure we understood details and answer any questions we had.The installation varied from the original plan and the installers discussed all changes with us to ensure that we were satisfied with the final installation. All of the workers conducting the installation were polite and easy to deal with, and left the premises in a neat condition when they were finished.The installation was completed only a few days ago and we are currently waiting for the grid connection to be completed. As the installers said, this will take a few days after the paperwork is all submitted by them.
Install was great. The guys weâ€™re friendly and did a great job.

I received 3 quotes from SolarQuotes website. 1 was competitive, but had little follow up; 1 was very good and a guy came out to review and explain things and the best approach to installation - and was very competitive, but again little follow up. I went with OTI Power, because Paul listened to my needs, gave great follow up and adjusted quotes pursuant to my questions and gave me great confidence in the company.  They also had very competitive pricing.Installation occurred within 2 weeks. The installation guys showed up on time, were very efficient, did a great job and cleaned up after themselves (unusual for tradespeople generally). I have been up on the roof since and the installation looks very professional.They arranged Energex meter changeover which also happened quickly.  I have now been generating consistently over 40 kw per day through winter. OTI even promptly resolved an Energex caused issue after the meter had been installed.The overall service from sales pitch to installation to post sales service has been great and I would definitely recommend them.

From quote to installation was only 7 days.  Pretty impressive and the aftersales assistance has been great, too.  It was great having regular contact with the salesman throughout the process to keep me aware of what was going on and what was needed.

I had the good fortune of getting a quote from Harrison Blake at OTI Power towards the beginning of 2020 for what was initially going to be a 6.6 kW system.That soon changed as I had a roof and aspect that would yield a much better return on investment from a larger system.Harrison taylor made a system that would be cost effective and advantageous to me and my family - we went for an 8.8kW system.The only hiccup we had was the sourcing of the panels from overseas due to the covid-19 outbreak in Feb/march. A little bit of patience and rescheduling and we were good to go.As anyone can imagine there is always going to be a certain amount of back and forth to get a small project like this up and running and Harrison was not shy to pick up the phone and get it organised.The installation team were great. Troy, Jesse, and mark showed up early and got it done very professionally. You know they're good when there's minimal chit chat between them about who's doing what and when. Thanks for fielding all my questions guys.If I had to go back and do it all again I would definitely pick the same people and also the same system.Further enquiries can be made to Harrison regarding my setup.Thank you Harrison for your help and your patience, it is greatly appreciated.

Informative and straight forward no high pressure selling.The guys doing the installation did clean tidy work and replaced some of our cracked roof tiles at no extra cost. ( We suppled the tiles)Customer service was great overall.

Harrison arrived on time, explained the options for solar, answered our questions and followed up with a preliminary quote of options from which we chose, then provided a definitive quote.  The installation was booked, solar panels delivered and then the installation was performed efficiently and by lunchtime the solar panels were operating.  We are very pleased with our choice of solar installer and would recommend him to anyone interested in putting solar panels on the roof.

OTI was punctual and attentive during the quotation process - didn't harass us but returned all calls. We were unsure as to whether we needed micro-inverters or optimisers and they did a great job in explaining their recommendation; in person, not just by phone/email (we went with optimisers). We were happy with the quality of all materials they used. Installation occurred on the designated day, without dramas, and the team were great; obviously knew what they were doing but asked appropriate questions as they went. Wiring was really tidy; panels worked immediately as per the app, which we love!

This is an excellent company. Wonderful customer service. Nothing was a problem.  Both sales and installation were superb. Very clean and tidy work. Great communication complete with quality follow up. I highly recommend Oti Power.

Harrison explained the preferred solution which we agreed with and provided a timely and well priced quote. The installation was delayed because of panel procurement issues (coronavirus), but ended up back on track. The installation team had good communication and worked efficiently.

OTI provided the best quote.  The installation was completed in Professional mannerwith the installer continuing to monitor all facets of the system.We would highly recommend OTI Power to anyone requiring Solar Panel solutions.

Paul for OTI Power at Sanctuary Cove has given a great service.The installation went like clockwork, very professional.Not the cheapest but good value for money.I highly recommend you consider ITI power when purchasing your solar system.

The salesman Grant was very great to deal with and I would recommend him to anyone looking to get solar installed.The Installation team that did the job were also very good and did a great job on the installation.As for Finn at Solar Quotes well what can I say, the information that you supplied was very helpful and made my decision a lot easier.The information on Inverters and Solar Panels that was on your website was very helpful.Thanks to you and your team for all your helpEd

Weâ€™d like to take the opportunity to express our sincere appreciation to Peter McLaren and his team for the amazing service and assistance provided in installing our solar system. For us installing solar was a major financial commitment, and there is a minefield of information and misinformation out there regarding solar. We wanted a high-quality system at a reasonable price. Peter was able to help us navigate the information, answer our many questions and help us decide on a system that will serve us well for the next 10 to 20 years.Peter assured us that their installation team were second to none and James and his team well and truly lived up to Peters recommendation. They were quick, efficient and very tidy.Peter and the OTI team have maintained contact with us since installation and have monitored our power output and system operation closely.  We wish to thank Peter and the OTI Power team for their commitment to outstanding customer service and delivery of a cost-efficient solar power supply. We would highly recommend OTI Power!

I am so pleased that I chose OTI Power to manage our solar system sale and install. The process was flawless and service was exceptional. I was very impressed with the effort that the team went to post install to ensure that we were happy. I highly recommend OTI Power.

Iâ€™ve had my solar installed for six months now, so itâ€™s time for a review.The company that installed was OTI Power, representative was Peter McLaren. Learning about solar from scratch is a daunting prospect. I did my due diligence, with multiple quotes, and Peter and OTI stood out by making sure that I understood the process of how solar power works and what the installation and hardware options are.I chose 21 315w REC panels with a 5kW Sungrow Inverter. I chose the panels because they appeared to be the best performers in my price range, with an excellent warranty that will likely see me out.I have a one story house with a fairly small roof area. Half the panels face north and half face west.The inverter has a WiFi dongle with an app (and website) that produces real-time data with reporting. Together with the electricity provider app, I can see how much solar I produce, and how it affects each dayâ€™s charges.The installation itself was flawless. OTI turned up on time, installed very quickly without a hitch, and left everything clean and tidy.As after-sales service, Peter has answered promptly any questions Iâ€™ve had about how everything works, and a hitch I had when the NBN was installed.My first bill was credit of $66, compared to $360 from the same period in the previous year. I anticipate breaking even on the solar investment in about four to five years, with time remaining on warranties.In conclusion, solar power is brilliant, OTI Power was a great choice for me, and thank you to Peter for making it easy.

Another company who was more positive about the solar analytics system actually quoted a little lower (slightly less efficient solar panels), but in the end I went with the company whose sales man convinced me that they would take care of me and who made a big song and dance about after-sales care. They nearly lost the sale because they are very unenthusiastic about the value of solar analytics, viewing it as an expensive waste of time and money. However, having been assured that any competent electrician can install the monitoring widget, I think/hope that their dismissive attitude towards it won't lead to a bad installation and I can get what I want from my preferred provider. Fingers crossed.

Hi FinnWhilst I did not go with one of the suppliers you had contact me, I can say that without your Website and the tremendous amount of quality information it contained, the journey I travelled towards the installation of Solar Power would have taken much longer. After further investigation I have had an 8Kw system installed with LG 335W panels and a Solaredge 8Kw Inverter and Optimisers. I apologise for not getting back to you sooner

Just wanted to say a HUGE thanks to you and the OTI Power team for your advice, professionalism and efficiency in setting up our new solar system!  The OTI team installed an 8.96Kwh system on our roof in Sanctuary Cove on 3-phase power back in August.  Up until receipt of our 1st bill yesterday, we had been running up energy bills averaging about $850 per quarter with worst bill last year over $1200!!  To our very pleasant surprise â€“ our first bill from Energy Australia was only $7.03 !!!  As a family we had been investigating quite a bit on solar energy and WHO would be the best installer to go with.  The tipping point was Paulâ€™s service over and above just installation, he also worked out the best Energy retailer based on solar rebates versus cost for us â€“ in our case Energy Australia.  NO other solar installer went to the detail that Paul and his team did â€“ so once again a HUGE thanks and canâ€™t recommend these guys highly enough if you are serious about solar!

The suggested installation was spot on.Harrison took into account our home design and suggested the optimum configuration and new black design panels which matched to our new roof.The installers were very professional. The job was installed exactly as proposed and the workmanship was excellent.They also worked around our availability schedule.Post installation we were shown how to operate the system and had several follow up calls to make sure all was OK.I highly recommend this Company.

The sales person came out to the property and walked through the design of the panel layout and well as the panel brands and the inverter monitoring. No one else did that. The price was reasonable for the quality of the panels and the inverter. The installation was professional and quick. The company also advised on the meter change and solar suitable electricity tariffs.

Professional, prompt service and quote process, but need to do plenty of research to ensure you get what you want when discussing requirements with representative.Installation very good quality an no out of pocket costs. We wanted a high end quality system of 10KW with 3 phase power with possible future connection to a battery, and that's what we received.Customer service and grid connection follow up very good. They will be doing a full review after first quarterly bill to recommend which plan and electricity vendor to migrate to, if required.

â€œOTI Power has been amazing to deal with for our solar installation. OTI Power worked with our builder to get as much as the cabling installed during construction and once we were ready they installed our solar system so efficiently. The install team were very helpful and set the monitoring system up for me before they left my home, no hassles at all. OTI Power not only delivered what they promised, they had unbeatable pricing, exceptional customer service and a friendly helpful install team. The follow up after installation to ensure we were with the correct/best energy supplier to best maximise our investment was also another great service. I would highly recommend OTI Powerâ€.

I appreciate all the information you provided me. I used it  to make comparisons between the range of products and services offered by two of your recommended suppliers and two others I researched about. The knowledge on your website gave me confidence in making the right decision, which was not just based on price.

Peter McLaren and his team have been nothing short of exceptional with communication and service! He even helped me move to a more suitable retailer with a direct contact. I am very happy so far. We will now have to wait and see what having solar really means to our power bill after using it for at least a quarter. Expecting to get connected to the grid in the next 15 days.

Right from the get go I was impressed with OTI. Harrison was outstanding, he knew his trade, he communicated, he listened, and frankly I was not surprised at the outcome. Installation went very well, they were on time, tidy and clearly capable. Jess led the install, genuine good guy who pointed out some other considerations with some potential issues with our electrical board to think about. Harrison took time in the set up of the applications and the consultation around the selection of our system. He also organized the grid connection and made some extra calls around feed in tariffs. It would be fair to say I am a hard marker, wouldn't hesitate in recommending OTI.
I am very pleased with all aspects of the process to date and happy to recommend Grant and OTi.
Very impressed with the installers. Did a great job and cleaned up after.Very professional. Couldn't be happier.

Harrison was personable and a pleasure to deal with throughout the end-to-end process - From quotation, installation, and post-installation handover!  He was always responsive and even spent time to run through the online/mobile app and how the solution worked.  We are over the moon to have finally cutover to solar, and it coudn't have happened without Harrison and the OTI Team.  Cheers!

Incredible service from Harrison. OTI was very patient when there were the inevitable delays on our side but when the time finally came, the installation was swift and hassle free. Now we are enjoying free electricity even though itâ€™s winter!

Harrison came at a time to suit us and on time. Really good and patient in answering questions and giving expert technical advice and explaining the issues.  No hard sell. Also, the best of 3 quotes. Installation turnaround time was much shorter than expected. The Installer (Jesse) was also on time, polite and proficient - no mess. After sales service good too - quick response time to questions and providing on-going advice to maximise the benefits. Happy to recommend.

We always get at least two quotes, but where you helped was to get us started on understanding what was available and providing three prequalified supplier/ installers. In the event, we decided to put in the best system we could afford, with longevity a major criteria.We contacted all three you suggested and two of our quotes were similar but on slightly different systems but the third one never quoted.OTIâ€™s installers were literally â€œ fantasticâ€ treating our roof tiles and us with respect.We went with OTI who were enthusiastic about solar and our location and recommended the individual panel optimisers with our REC panels and SolarEdge inverter.With 36 panels ( 10.6KW) installed we got over 50 KWH most days until it rained and now we are sitting just under 50 as the days shorten. In summer we expect to do better than 50.While itâ€™s still early days, we are enthusiastic solar power producers.Thanks for the service.

Harrison from OTI Power was a pleasure to deal with from start to finish. He organised to come out to see me within a couple of days of my call and I had the quotes sent to me the same day. Any questions I had were answered quickly and honestly. It was a pleasure to deal with a company that really looks after their customers, and operates in such a professional manner both before, during and after the installation.Our solar was installed a week after we accepted the quote. The team who did the installation were fantastic and were also a pleasure to deal with. Our job had it's challenges but they worked tirelessly to get it done and we couldn't be happier with the quality of their workmanship. They were polite, turned up on time and left the job spotless. I cannot rate OTI Power highly enough and have already recommended them to other people interested in getting solar.

The salesman (Harrison Blake) from OTI power is very helpful,  his quick response on text and email is very fast, even during easter holiday.   The replies  are always  honest,  simple and quick to understand.Although the price is not the cheapest one, but i think the system which  they offered is very good for value, and best for my home requirements. .Although, during the installation part of the roof was damaged, but they agreed to fixed for me, so i am very appreciated their workmanship and attitude.Since the installation, the system is running so far so good,  I have no problem recommend OTI Power to anyone..

Huge thank you, to Paul and the team at OTI Power.It has been such a pleasure from the initial conversation to the finished product.Great to have a company who puts the customer first and is professional from start to finish.Sam and the install team were great, very friendly & experienced team.We would highly recommend using OTI Power for confidence in the right product, to fantastic customer service.Many thanksSally

Firstly I'm not being payed for the following comments.Harrison from OTI was great to work with. He and his team were professional, on-time with a tidy and clean work area. The system was completed and commissioned in one day.Thank you Blake and the team from OTI

Extremely pleased with OTI Power and ever so grateful to you for providing the recommendation along with the other companies - I also obtained quotes from them, but was disappointed with them as the only contact was by phone while I was driving and I found it difficult to communicate. Hawking was very keen for the quote to be successful. But the winner for me was OTI as they are very local, Peter is a partner in the business, they could install within 2 weeks and connected to the meter box upon installation so I can see the meter going backwards and follow the activity on the app. I was totally convinced when they didnâ€™t want a deposit or payment until I was satisfied. The day after installation (which all went very smoothly as planned) I had a problem with the app receiving data. Next morning Peter was here to resolve the issue. Amazing post installation customer service.

I can not fault OTI Power.  Josh from OTI Power was able to offer the best deal I could find for a 16 LG panel installation with Enphase microinverters, and worked with me to be completely accommodating to all of my enquries and my specific installation needs.  Communications at every stage were clear and open.  The installers were polite and did an excellent job.  I can't recommend OTI Power enough.
Excellent service during installation.  An issue with the set up on the inverter / smart meter that gave incorrect readings on the site was corrected quickly.

The only problem I had was we haven't been informed that we have to give the access inside the house to go the manhole. So they had to come next day to finish the job. Also inverter has been installed outside the house not inside the garage since it will cost more to do so. This was got to know the day they came for the installation and not in the quotation. First they recommended to install the inverter inside and then they changed the word saying warranty covers everything.
OTI Power provided a great solar experience form start to finish and continue to look after us by keeping me up to date with the best power deals available.

I cannot rate OTI Power highly enough, after a year of investigating solar for our business premises and dealing with very sub standard suppliers and inadequate product that was over priced, we came across OTI Power. Their customer service is far superior than any competitor, a system that was scoped correctly from the onset and installed with precision. We immediately can see the benefits and can be monitored from the apps installed on our phones and to know this will pay for itself in just four years is the best business decision we have made. I cannot rate the end to end service solutions enough. We have also gone with OTI Power for our home. Also to be informed we get a 25 year warranty!

OTI were by far the most professional company during the quotation process. Peter is genuine and provided advice that suited our applications. In fact we decided on one system for the business and one for our domestic situation. We await the installation and customer service process.

Excellent Customer Service from Josh Kwanten. Follow ups to explain Solar Edge APP and website was very beneficial.Josh provided outstanding information on the solar product and kept us updated on all aspects during the installation.An "On site Visit" from Josh and Harry before installation of the solar panels was much appreciated.I would certainly recommend Josh Kwanten - Oti Power Representative to family and friends for Oti solar quotes.

We got 3 quotes and OTI was hands down the most professional and trustworthy. They gave us lots of information and options and their prices were competitive. All the way through the process, their service was outstanding. They got everything organised, turned up on time and over-delivered on every promise. Getting solar installed is a long, complicated process that relies on your power provider. Ours was incredibly slow, but OTI chased them up and were there to advise us every step of the way. Six months later and our $1,000 quarterly power bill is now $200.  We couldn't be more satisfied. You can trust these guys - they're great.
I would like to thank Peter from OTI power for the great deal on my solar system and great advice and service. Peter made everything so easy.
The clincher was that OTI was the only company to site visit before finalising the quote.

The team at OTI Power were fantastic.  As someone who has been looking at getting solar panels for the past 5 years we were thrilled with their expertise, service and quick installation.  They also know what they are doing (which is great given all the questionable solar businesses with ignorant call centre sales people that are promoting cheap solar panel systems that are rubbish).  I would highly recommend Blake and the OTI Power team.

Hamish from Oti Power was very informative, efficient and pleasant to deal with. The material he supplied helped us understand why Oti Power were recommending the particular panels and other components for our house and needs. This made it easier for us to compare the quotes we obtained from three different suppliers before making the decision to go with the system Oti Power recommended.We have since recommended Oti Power to our neighbours and tennis friends interested in getting solar panels installed and passed on Hamish's contact details to them.
Excellent experience - however as only recently installed the proof will be in the pudding if after sales service is required.However, at this time the system is working very well.
